name: Torredonjimeno (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and white, crossed by a green band edged white from the lower hoist to the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Torredonjimeno; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band edged with white and green stripes from the lower hoist to the upper fly
